decisions.reason: A safety shoe line sits squarely in the firm's core leather footwear knowledge, so management can read early results and refine the line with in-house expertise.
A comfort insole is closely related to the firm's work shoe know-how and works as an accessory, though it overlaps with the other insoles and could be merged later.
A supportive insole draws on the firm's ergonomic footwear knowledge, but it is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with B and F, which makes it the most likely insole to be consolidated.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own page, signalling strategic priority, and it builds directly on the firm's R&D strengths in work footwear.
Firefighter boots extend the firm's protective footwear competence into a demanding certified niche where its accumulated knowledge gives it an edge.
The moulded insole is featured on the home page, showing management commitment, and it complements the firm's core work shoe range.
